meta.name: Washington insurance claim-handling rules (Clean Save compliance database)
meta.verification_status: UNVERIFIED: the 2026-10-18 amendments come from a United Policyholders summary, not from the adopted WAC text. Confirm each citation against the WAC or OIC public notices before quoting it to a carrier, then set verified=true on that rule.

day_types.business: Mon-Fri, excluding Washington state legal holidays. WAC uses both 'working days' and 'business days'; treated the same here.

owner_types.carrier: A deadline the insurer owes. If missed, it is leverage for us and the homeowner, not a violation by Clean Save.
owner_types.cleansave: Something Clean Save must do (or avoid) to protect the job, the homeowner, or our license.

rules.title: Insurer acknowledges the claim
rules.catch: No acknowledgment recorded within 10 business days of the claim being reported.
rules.action: Note it in the job log. Have the homeowner ask the adjuster for written acknowledgment and cite the rule if it stays silent.

rules.title: Insurer replies to communications that expect a response
rules.catch: Any outbound message to the carrier that expected a reply has no reply logged after 10 business days.
rules.action: Send a dated follow-up referencing the original message and the 10-day reply rule.

rules.title: Insurer approves our emergency mitigation scope or gives its own approved scope
rules.catch: Mitigation scope was sent and no approval or carrier scope has come back within 5 business days.
rules.action: Send templates/mitigation-scope-followup.md. Keep working to S500; document every day.

rules.title: A rejected mitigation scope must come with reasons and itemized disallowed amounts
rules.catch: Carrier rejected or cut the mitigation scope without a written reason or without itemizing the disallowed amounts.
rules.action: Request the written reason and line-item list. That list becomes the base of the /supplement.

rules.title: Investigation complete within 30 days, or written status notices
rules.catch: Day 30 passed with no decision and no written status notice. New rule: the notice must summarize decisions, list outstanding items, and confirm a new adjuster reviewed the file.
rules.action: Homeowner requests a written status notice. Flag the file for escalation (supervisor, then OIC complaint).

rules.title: Accept or deny within 30 calendar days of notice of claim
rules.catch: No accept or deny decision 30 calendar days after the claim was reported.
rules.action: Escalate. Pre-2026-10-18 claims use the old rule (15 working days after proof of loss), checked by WA-DECIDE-15-LEGACY.

rules.title: Accept or deny within 15 working days of proof of loss (claims before the 2026 change)
rules.catch: No decision 15 business days after a signed proof of loss.

rules.title: Denials in writing, citing the policy provision
rules.catch: Full or partial denial without a written letter naming the policy provision.
rules.action: Homeowner requests the written denial with the policy provision. Do not start a supplement until you have it.

rules.title: Claim file materials within 15 business days of request
rules.catch: Requested claim file (notes, estimates, photos, measurements, communications) not received within 15 business days, or withheld items not disclosed.
rules.action: Follow up citing the rule. Use the carrier's own estimate and notes to build the supplement.

rules.title: Pricing can't rest only on a database or estimating software; source data on request

deadline.note: No fixed deadline in the summary; 15 business days used as an internal follow-up trigger.

rules.catch: Carrier cut rates or quantities 'per price list' and has not provided the date, location and suppliers behind its numbers.
rules.action: Send templates/pricing-data-request.md. Attach field logs and meter readings to show the work was needed.

rules.title: Send the mitigation scope to the carrier in writing, early
rules.catch: Insurance job started and no written mitigation scope has been sent to the carrier by the next business day.
rules.action: Email the scope (rooms, category/class, equipment plan, estimated days) to the adjuster and log the date. No written scope means no 5-day clock.

rules.title: Every carrier contact logged with date, name and method
rules.citation: Internal; supports every carrier deadline and the supplement escalation ladder
rules.satisfied_by: claim.communications[] non-empty with date and contact
rules.catch: Insurance job with no logged carrier communications, or entries missing a date or contact name.
rules.action: Backfill the log today from email and phone history.

rules.title: No permanent repairs before inspection without written OK
rules.citation: UP guidance: insurer may deny if permanent repairs precede inspection
rules.catch: Rebuild or permanent repair started before the carrier inspected, with no written approval on file.
rules.action: Stop permanent work. Get written approval from the adjuster first. Mitigation (emergency) work is fine.

rules.title: We document and invoice our work. We don't negotiate the homeowner's claim.
rules.citation: RCW 48.17 (adjuster licensing). Confirm scope with counsel.
rules.catch: Any letter, call or web copy where Clean Save negotiates coverage or settlement for the homeowner, or claims to 'handle your claim'.
rules.action: Limit our communications to our own scope, pricing and documentation. Coverage disputes go to the homeowner, a licensed public adjuster, or an attorney. Letters that invoke a policyholder right are sent or signed by the homeowner.
